captured: 2026-08-27, before the immersive restyle of public/css/style.css
why: The restyle rewrites one stylesheet that all 52 pages depend on. These behaviours are CSS-coupled and can break silently.

faq_accordion.mechanism: public/js/main.js toggles .open on .faq-item and syncs aria-expanded. The collapse itself is CSS: .faq-answer height 0 when closed.
faq_accordion.risk: 215 accordion instances. If .faq-answer loses its height rule or .faq-item.open loses its expanded rule, every FAQ on the site is either permanently open or permanently shut.

scroll_reveal.mechanism: main.js IntersectionObserver adds .visible to .fade-in. Non-IO browsers get everything revealed immediately.
scroll_reveal.risk: 581 .fade-in elements sitewide. If .fade-in defaults to opacity 0 and the observer does not fire, or a new script double-binds it, every page ships invisible content.

warp_grid.mechanism: main.js injects canvas.warp-grid and sets .has-warp-grid on the host, which hides the static CSS grid.
warp_grid.risk: If .has-warp-grid loses its rule, the static grid and the canvas both render.

calculators.mechanism: main.js binds #calcValue, #calcLeads, #calcMonth and the lead-value set (#lvMargin, #lvProfit, #lvMaxCpl).
calculators.risk: Range inputs are heavily styled per browser. A restyle that misses ::-webkit-slider-thumb leaves an invisible handle.

free_audit_tool.mechanism: 2140 lines, 8-screen funnel, 18-check analyser, report renderer, Web3Forms delivery.
free_audit_tool.risk: Largest and most stateful page on the site. Screen switching is likely class-driven and therefore CSS-coupled.
